note: Net cash-market flows in crore rupees for the latest session, plus whatever history has accumulated. Positive means net buying. FII and DII often move in opposite directions on the same day.

cautions.sign: netValue is in ₹ crore. Positive is net buying, negative is net selling.
cautions.history: NSE's endpoint returns only the latest session, so the history here is as long as this pipeline has been running - not back to 2019.
cautions.provisional: These are provisional figures and NSE revises them. Treat the last day as indicative.
